(async () => { const m = await import('/v5/js/world/mainland/plan.js'); window.__plan = m; const g=window.__game; const D=g.daynight; if (D && D.setHour) D.setHour(13); const hb = m.M_BLOCKS.find(b => b.kind === 'calle'); window.__hb = hb; g.world.mainland.fill({x:hb.cx, z:hb.cz}, 30000); g.player.spawn(hb.rect.x1 + 2.6, hb.cz, Math.PI); window.__goShop = (re, dx, yawOff, side) => { const p = g.player.pos; const list = g.world.shops.filter(s => s.room && s.door && re.test(s.kind)).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.door[0]-p.x,a.door[2]-p.z)-Math.hypot(b.door[0]-p.x,b.door[2]-p.z)); const s = list[0]; if (!s) return 'none'; window.__shop = s; const R = s.room; const c = R.center; const fx = R.facade.nx, fz = R.facade.nz; g.world.interiors.fill(c.x, c.z, 20000); const rx = -fz, rz = fx; g.player.spawn(c.x + fx*(dx||1.5) + rx*(side||0), c.z + fz*(dx||1.5) + rz*(side||0), Math.atan2(-fx, -fz)); g.camRig.yaw = Math.atan2(-fx, -fz) + (yawOff||0); g.camRig.pitch = 0.12; return s.kind + ':' + s.name; }; window.__shopInfo = () => { const s = window.__shop; const a = s && g.streetlife.active.get(s.id); if (!a) return 'not active'; return { n: a.visitors.length, q: a.queue.length, payer: a.payer ? a.payer.phase : null, ph: a.visitors.map(v => v.phase + (v.st ? '/' + v.st : '') + (v.c.fig.carryL ? '+' + v.c.fig.carryL : '') + (v.c.fig.carry ? '+' + v.c.fig.carry : '')).join(' '), extras: a.extras.length, staff: !!a.staffer }; }; return { hb: [hb.col, hb.row], int: g.world.interiors.info() }; })()
(() => { const g = window.__game; g.world.shops.forEach(s => s.muralChance = 0); if (g.world.mainland && g.world.mainland.stream) g.world.mainland.stream.scale = 0.45; return 'capped'; })()

(async () => { const g = window.__game, P = g.player; const F = async (n, k = 1) => { for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) { window.__frame(n); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 20)); } }; window.__camOverride = null; const s = g.world.shops.find(q => q.id === 100024); if (!s) return 'no shop 100024'; window.__shop = s; const R = s.room; const c = R.center; const fx = R.facade.nx, fz = R.facade.nz; g.world.interiors.fill(c.x, c.z, 20000); P.spawn(c.x + fx * 1.8, c.z + fz * 1.8, Math.atan2(-fx, -fz)); await F(30, 2); await F(60, 3); return s.kind + ':' + s.name; })()

(async () => { const g = window.__game, P = g.player; const F = async (n, k = 1) => { for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) { window.__frame(n); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 20)); } }; window.__camOverride = null; if (g.events) g.events.t = 1e9; const st = g.world.mainland.stream; st.scale = 1; let n = 0; while (n++ < 80 && !g.world.shops.some(q => q.kind === 'sports' && q.room && q.door)) await F(30); st.scale = 0.45; const p = P.pos; const list = g.world.shops.filter(s => s.room && s.door && s.kind === 'sports').sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.door[0]-p.x,a.door[2]-p.z)-Math.hypot(b.door[0]-p.x,b.door[2]-p.z)); const s = list[0]; if (!s) return 'none'; window.__shop = s; const R = s.room; const c = R.center; g.world.interiors.fill(c.x, c.z, 20000); P.spawn(c.x + R.facade.nx * 1.8, c.z + R.facade.nz * 1.8, Math.atan2(-R.facade.nx, -R.facade.nz)); await F(30, 2); await F(60, 3); return s.kind + ':' + s.name + ' ' + s.id + ' (' + n + ')'; })()

(async () => { const g = window.__game, P = g.player; const F = async (n, k = 1) => { for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) { window.__frame(n); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 20)); } }; const s = window.__shop; const R = s.room; const f = R.facade; const C = R.corners; const tx = R.center.x - C[0].x, tz = R.center.z - C[0].z; const tl = Math.hypot(tx, tz) || 1; const fc = C[0]; P.spawn(fc.x + tx / tl * 1.0, fc.z + tz / tl * 1.0, 0); const bm = { x: (C[2].x + C[3].x) / 2, z: (C[2].z + C[3].z) / 2 }; window.__camOverride = { pos: [fc.x + tx / tl * 0.95, R.floor + R.height - 0.3, fc.z + tz / tl * 0.95], look: [bm.x + f.nx * 1.5, R.floor + 0.8, bm.z + f.nz * 1.5] }; await F(30, 2); return s.kind + ':' + s.name; })()
